entries.name: Alec Pierce
entries.summary: Colts head coach Shane Steichen said Wednesday that Pierce (heel) will be placed on injured reserve and is without a timeline for a return, Kevin Bowen of 107.5 The Fan Indianapolis reports.

entries.name: Andrei Iosivas
entries.summary: Bengals head coach Zac Taylor said Wednesday that Iosivas tore a ligament in his thumb and will be placed on injured reserve, Ben Baby of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Ashton Dulin
entries.summary: Dulin (ankle) did not practice Thursday.

entries.name: Brandon Aiyuk
entries.summary: Head coach Kyle Shanahan said Sunday that he's not viewing Aiyuk as an option for the 49ers while the club contends with multiple injuries at receiver, Matt Barrows of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Caleb Douglas
entries.summary: Douglas (ankle) won't play Sunday against the Chiefs, C. Isaiah Smalls II of the Miami Herald reports.

entries.name: Charlie Kolar
entries.summary: Chargers head coach Jim Harbaugh said Wednesday that Kolar (forearm) won't play Sunday in Buffalo but is expected to avoid placement on injured reserve, Kris Rhim of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Cooper Rush
entries.summary: Rush (coach's decision) is inactive for Thursday's game versus Green Bay but will serve as the emergency quarterback.

entries.name: Demarcus Robinson
entries.summary: San Francisco head coach Kyle Shanahan said that Robinson is facing a recovery timeline of 3-to-6 weeks after sustaining a high-ankle sprain in Sunday's 35-13 win over the Dolphins, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Jayden Daniels
entries.summary: Commanders GM Adam Peters, via JP Finlay of NBC Sports Washington, said Friday morning that "as of right now surgery is not on the table" for Daniels (elbow) and that the team "has not discussed" placing him on injured reserve.

entries.name: Jayden Reed
entries.summary: inactive

entries.name: Mason Taylor
entries.summary: Taylor (thumb) has been ruled out for Sunday's game at Detroit.

entries.name: Zach Charbonnet
entries.summary: Head coach Mike Macdonald said Wednesday that the Seahawks won't open Charbonnet's (knee) practice window this week, John Boyle of the team's official site reports.

entries.name: Caleb Williams
entries.summary: Williams (hamstring) was listed as a non-participant on Thursday's estimated practice report.

entries.name: Chig Okonkwo
entries.summary: Commanders coach Dan Quinn said Friday that Okonkwo (hamstring) is a long shot to play Sunday against the Seahawks, Tashan Reed of The Washington Post reports.

entries.name: Dallas Goedert
entries.summary: Goedert (knee) was a non-participant at Thursday's practice.

entries.name: Jaylen Wright
entries.summary: Wright (foot) is considered doubtful for Sunday's game against Kansas City, Travis Wingfield of the Dolphins' official site reports.

entries.name: Nico Collins
entries.summary: Collins (hamstring) isn't practicing Friday and is slated to miss a second game in a row, Aaron Wilson reports.

entries.name: Aaron Jones Sr.
entries.summary: Jones (knee) was present for the open portion of Thursday's practice, Kevin Seifert of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Adonai Mitchell
entries.summary: Mitchell (finger) will be limited in Friday's practice, according to the Jets' official X account.

entries.name: Aidan O'Connell
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Barion Brown
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Brenen Thompson
entries.summary: Thompson (quadriceps) did not practice Thursday.

entries.name: Brock Bowers
entries.summary: Bowers (knee) is practicing for a second straight day Thursday, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Chris Bell
entries.summary: Bell (knee) "mostly worked on the side" during the media-viewing portion of Thursday's practice, David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

entries.name: Chris Moore
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Colby Parkinson
entries.summary: Parkinson (knee) did not participate in practice Thursday, Nate Atkins of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Daniel Bellinger
entries.summary: Bellinger (illness) did not participate in practice Thursday, Turron Davenport of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: DeeJay Dallas
entries.summary: Dallas (toe) was a limited participant in Thursday's practice.

entries.name: DeVonta Smith
entries.summary: Smith didn't practice Thursday due to a hamstring injury.

entries.name: DJ Moore
entries.summary: Moore (shoulder) was not spotted on the practice field at the beginning of Thursday's session, Joe Buscaglia of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Eli Raridon
entries.summary: Raridon (thigh) did not practice Thursday.

entries.name: Jadarian Price
entries.summary: Price (chest) was limited in practice Thursday, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.

entries.name: Jakobi Meyers
entries.summary: Meyers (thumb) was a limited participant Thursday.

entries.name: Jalen Coker
entries.summary: Coker (ankle) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game, Steve Reed of the Associated Press reports.

entries.name: Jaylen Warren
entries.summary: Warren (shoulder) was in uniform and participating during the portion of Thursday's practice open to the media, Nick Farabaugh of PennLive.com reports.

entries.name: Jaylin Lane
entries.summary: Lane returned six kickoffs for 120 yards and one punt for 14 yards in Sunday's 37-20 loss to the Cowboys.

entries.name: Jonah Coleman
entries.summary: Coleman (ankle) was listed as a non-participant on Thursday's injury report.

entries.name: Jordan Whittington
entries.summary: Whittington (quadriceps) was a limited participant in practice Thursday, Nate Atkins of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Kendre Miller
entries.summary: Miller was a non-participant in Thursday's practice due to an illness, Mike Triplett of NewOrleans.Football reports.

entries.name: Kene Nwangwu
entries.summary: Nwangwu (back) did not participate in practice Thursday.

entries.name: Keon Coleman
entries.summary: Coleman (ankle) wasn't spotted at the start of Thursday's practice, Joe Buscaglia of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Kyle Monangai
entries.summary: Monangai (knee) was listed as a DNP on Thursday's practice estimate.

entries.name: LeQuint Allen Jr.
entries.summary: Allen (hip) was limited in practice Thursday.

entries.name: Marvin Mims Jr.
entries.summary: Mims (foot) logged another limited practice Thursday.

entries.name: Michael Pittman Jr.
entries.summary: Pittman (foot) was a limited participant at Thursday's practice, Alan Saunders of Steelers Now reports.

entries.name: Mike Evans
entries.summary: Evans (hip) didn't participate in Thursday's practice, Harrison Rich of the San Francisco Chronicle reports.

entries.name: Puka Nacua
entries.summary: Nacua (hip) didn't take part in Thursday's practice, Sarah Barshop of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Rico Dowdle
entries.summary: Dowdle (toe) was not spotted during the open viewing window of Friday's practice, Ray Fittipaldo reports.

entries.name: Ryan Miller
entries.summary: Miller (hip) did not practice Thursday.

entries.name: Saquon Barkley
entries.summary: Barkley (stinger) practiced on a limited basis Thursday.

entries.name: Tank Bigsby
entries.summary: Bigsby (hamstring) didn't participate in Thursday's practice.

entries.name: Tony Pollard
entries.summary: Pollard (ankle) will be a full participant in Friday's practice, Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site reports.

entries.name: Travis Etienne Jr.
entries.summary: Etienne (hamstring) practiced in a limited capacity Thursday, Mike Triplett of NewOrleans.Football reports.

entries.name: Tyjae Spears
entries.summary: Spears (ankle) was listed as limited for Friday's practice, Terry McCormick of TitanInsider reports.

entries.name: Tyson Bagent
entries.summary: Bagent (concussion) was listed as a non-participant on Thursday's practice estimate.

entries.name: Will Shipley
entries.summary: Shipley (foot) did not participate in practice Thursday.

entries.name: Xavier Legette
entries.summary: Legette (knee) was listed as a non-participant at Thursday's practice.

entries.name: Zay Flowers
entries.summary: The Ravens listed Flowers (hamstring) as a non-participant in Thursday's practice.

entries.name: Arian Smith
entries.summary: Smith (knee) underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn ACL and will miss the rest of the season, Antwan V. Staley of the New York Daily News reports.

entries.name: David Njoku
entries.summary: The Chargers placed Njoku (fibula) on injured reserve Wednesday.

entries.name: Jaxson Dart
entries.summary: The Giants officially placed Dart (knee) on injured reserve Thursday, Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Jonathon Brooks
entries.summary: Brooks is expected to undergo surgery Wednesday to repair a core-muscle injury and is likely to miss at least six weeks, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Ronnie Rivers
entries.summary: The Rams placed Rivers (calf) on their injured reserve list Wednesday.
